name: Stormwind Keep: the Petitioner's Chamber door won't budge from the chamber until the character opens it from the hallway
contract: Review item #10 and the user's live description (2026-10-15): the Stomwind Keep Door 2300653 (type 0, display 300553 stormwind_castle_noble_door, auto-close 5000 ms) sits in the keep doorway at about (-8279.70, 269.48) between the Petitioner's Chamber rooms and the hallway that runs north-east to the tower. Used from the chamber side before the character has ever opened it, it stays shut and says it won't budge; used from the hallway side it opens. Once a character has opened it from the hallway, it opens from either side for that character. The case joins world phase 1 and uses the world spawn 9999303; a summoned door would despawn when it closes. The exact live wording is unknown; the notice is matched on 'budge'.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the door is spawned
Try the door from the chamber side first
the character is told the door won't budge
and nothing is remembered for the character
Walk round to the hallway side
SETUP: the character stands on the hallway side
Open the door from the hallway
the door opens from the hallway
and the character remembers opening it
the door closes again by itself
Go back to the chamber side
SETUP: the character stands on the chamber side
Try the door from the chamber side again
now it opens from the chamber side too
